title: Chapter 6170: Seal And Support

Chapter 6170: Seal And Support

Chapter 6170: Seal And Support

Emotions ran strong among the crowd after witnessing Transcendent Emperor’s death and the destruction of the dynasty.

He had the chance to leave unscathed yet he refused, preferring death. His loyalty and devotion couldn’t be overstated.

An emperor had ample freedom in life and didn’t need to rely on a sect or kingdom. Thus, some roamed the world and severed all attachments. They had no problem watching the destruction of sects they had founded or the death of their descendants.

This was just the way of cultivation. When one became stronger, their attachment to the mortal world weakened.

Transcendent could have become a primal ancestor or even a supreme overlord. Thus, his sacrifice to maintain his principles became more admirable. Anyone else with a similar talent would have left the dynasty to search for a greater height.

“A brilliant genius, dead just like that.” Others mourned his demise.

“He lived up to his talent and fame.” A big shot said.

Despite losing and being killed, the crowd only admired him more - a boost to his legacy.

At this point, Li Qiye continued delving deeper into what was left of the dynasty. Remnant seals broke down, freeing the members of Enigma.

They rushed over to greet him. He waved his hand and they left without a second word.

He didn’t stop and reached the forbidden grounds with unbreakable seals. Few had the privilege of entering this place without permission.

It served as the most sacred area of the dynasty and was its source - Immortal Suppression Grotto, the abode of Immortal Suppressor.

Since the founding of the dynasty, he rarely left this place so only a selected few saw him in person.

Some said this was due to his lifespan depleting. The resources in the grotto helped him survive for longer. Others stated his seclusion was for cultivation.

Regardless of the reason, he remained the highest point of authority in Immortal Suppression Dynasty.

Li Qiye had destroyed emperors and territories but as long as Immortal Suppressor was still alive, the dynasty could rise again.

“This is similar to Hidden Ancestor of Enigma.” Someone remarked.

“That’s why they tried so hard to find Hidden Ancestor, it’s the only way to truly uproot Enigma. The same applies here.” A desolate god agreed.

The issue was that no one dared to talk about killing Immortal Suppressor before.

“Bam!” Li Qiye waved and destroyed all the seals. Nothing could slow him down.

“No one else can do this.” Spectators were amazed since he was the first to break into this grotto.

“This is invincibility.” An emperor said.

Everyone gazed into the grotto and saw a world of dao. Stars were carved into towering trees, palaces, and paradises…

This was an independent world with magnificent visual spectacles. Waterfalls made of the dao flowed downward. Stars were in gestation, waiting for full emergence.

“This is something else.” They were amazed at this sight.

Emperors and desolate gods could create personal grottos but none to this level. If this grotto were a palace, then theirs were mere grass huts.

“This is built and accumulated through many eras, it’s not out of the question.” A big shot said.

“You’re here, Dao Brother.” A matchless voice echoed, one befitting the lord of not only this grotto but all of Sin.

“Buzz.” Something flashed like a big bang - a young man appeared sitting on a supreme lotus throne made from auspicious stars.

His palm raising outward could seal the myriad realms of heaven and earth. His left hand resting on his dantian could support the universe for ages.

The celestial circled him with the dao being born above his head. When he spoke, he was the world itself and inspired an urge to prostrate.
